tools.name: mailbox_send
tools.title: Write a letter
tools.description: File a letter to this agent's person: a request only they can answer, with the options their answer picks from. The answer comes back to the sender.

kind.description: decide: pick one of 2 to 5 options; do: a task only they can do; accept: approve finished work; know: something they should know.

subject.description: What is asked, in one line of at most 80 characters.

whyOnlyYou.description: Why only the person can answer, at most 200 characters; required unless kind is know.

body.description: What the person needs to answer, in Markdown, at most 4,000 characters. It may run over several lines.

options.description: For a decide letter only: 2 to 5 options, each { label, effect }. Labels are words, without dashes, each its own.

items.description: One answer the person can pick.

label.description: The option's words, at most 40 characters.

effect.description: What happens when the person picks it, at most 160 characters.

links.description: Pages the person may want while answering, at most 10, each { label, url }.

dedupeKey.description: A key of yours for this question: a send with a key you used before returns that letter instead of filing another.

holdUntil.description: "interactive" to hold it for a session with the person, or an ISO time.

expiresAt.description: An ISO time after which the question is moot, such as 2026-12-01T17:00:00Z.

lane.description: Where you ask from, such as a desk task path, so the person knows who waits.

tools.name: mailbox_list
tools.title: Letters
tools.description: List the letters this agent's person has been sent that still wait for an answer, oldest first, or every letter with all. Read only.

all.description: List answered, withdrawn and expired letters too.

mine.description: Only the letters this agent filed.

tools.name: mailbox_read
tools.title: Read a letter
tools.description: Read one letter by id or code: what it asks, its options, its state and every event, such as when it was seen. Read only.

letter.description: The letter's id (ltr_…) or its code (L7).

tools.name: mailbox_wait
tools.title: Wait for an answer
tools.description: Block until a letter leaves waiting or the timeout ends, then return its state and a cursor to pass next time. Read only.

letter.description: The letter's id (ltr_…) or its code (L7).

cursor.description: The cursor the last wait returned; events after it count.

tools.name: mailbox_withdraw
tools.title: Withdraw a letter
tools.description: Take back a waiting letter this agent filed, with the reason, so the person stops seeing it.

letter.description: The letter's id (ltr_…) or its code (L7).

reason.description: Why it no longer needs an answer, in one line.

tools.name: mailbox_deliver
tools.title: Deliver a letter
tools.description: Ask Ouro to send a waiting letter to the person's own chat now, rendered by Ouro, and record that it was delivered.

letter.description: The letter's id (ltr_…) or its code (L7).

mailbox_answer.summary: Answer a letter: You can't answer a letter for the person; only they can. Ask the person, who does it by replying to the letter in their chat, such as "L7 2".

error.problem: You can't answer a letter for the person; only they can. Ask the person, who does it by replying to the letter in their chat, such as "L7 2"
error.message: Answer a letter: You can't answer a letter for the person; only they can. Ask the person, who does it by replying to the letter in their chat, such as "L7 2".
